raw:
SELECT 
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(points), 0) FROM results r JOIN races rc ON r.raceId = rc.raceId JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId WHERE d.forename = 'Jenson' AND d.surname = 'Button' AND rc.year = 2010) -
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(points), 0) FROM results r JOIN races rc ON r.raceId = rc.raceId JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId WHERE d.forename = 'Jenson' AND d.surname = 'Button' AND rc.year = 2009) AS difference
